title: uibc-core: Verifiable Evidence Packages for Autonomous AI Agents
description:
uibc-core is the reference implementation of UIBC (Uniform Identity-Behavior Chain): verifiable evidence packages for autonomous AI agents, built on the LGD principles of Registry, Evidence and Gates.

Every agent action can be sealed into a submission.uibc package — identity record + lifecycle events + content-hashed evidence + evidence root + optional owner seal (HMAC-SHA256 or Ed25519 signature) — and then verified offline by any third party, with no trust in the producing system required.

The repository ships: a pure-standard-library CLI (uibc), an independent zero-dependency verifier for cross-implementation checks, registry scaffolding for certificates / revocations / disputes (read paths only; no write endpoint is deployed), a read-only MCP server, and an A2A HTTP adapter. Test and conformance-vector counts are deliberately not restated here — the current figures live in the README and docs/CONFORMANCE.md, where they can be re-run.

Status: PROPOSAL, not a formal standard. Verification results are scoped proofs: PASS means "no violation found within the observed evidence boundary", not an absolute claim of trustworthiness. The honest boundary is documented and machine-readable in the repository.
